manifest.title: Showcase: wettability and corrosion of a steel specimen
manifest.summary: A complete, pre-computed WETCOR AI test for demonstrations. The contact angle is measured by WETCOR AI on a real sessile-drop frame from a commercial goniometer (public image). The electrochemical runs are SYNTHETIC curves for a steel-like specimen. Replace the files and this manifest with your own steel-plate test to make the showcase yours.

specimen.notes: Showcase specimen. Contact-angle image is a public stand-in frame (substrate not documented by its author); electrochemical data are synthetic.

experiment.instrument: Goniometer frame: Attension Theta (public image). Electrochemistry: synthetic generator.
experiment.procedure: Sessile drop of deionised water, back-lit side view; OCP 30 min then potentiodynamic polarisation +/-300 mV vs E_corr at 1 mV steps (synthetic).

source.title: Contact angle measurement with Attension Theta
source.author: Jyrkorpela
source.substrate: not documented by the author (used here as a stand-in for a steel plate)

preprocessing: Cropped to the camera viewport (x 95-610, y 28-378 px of the 961 x 542 screenshot).
Third-party orange overlay (angle labels, baseline, volume text) removed by OpenCV Telea inpainting of 1800 px; nothing else altered. Script: scripts/prepare_showcase_image.py.
contact_angle.correction_reason: Automatic baseline detection fails because the reflective surface mirrors the drop; the baseline was placed on the mirror axis (narrowest row, y = 299 px) between the drop and its reflection.

reference.source: Reading of the instrument's own software visible in the original frame (Young-Laplace fit)

metrics.name: i_corr
metrics.label: Corrosion current density i_corr (Tafel extrapolation)
metrics.formula: log10 i_corr at the intersection of anodic and cathodic Tafel lines
assumptions: Both regions are activation controlled (linear in E vs log|i|).
Current density uses the recorded exposed area.
Ohmic drop negligible or compensated.

metrics.name: e_corr_tafel
metrics.label: E_corr at Tafel intersection
metrics.formula: E at intersection of Tafel lines
assumptions: Both regions are activation controlled (linear in E vs log|i|).
Current density uses the recorded exposed area.
Ohmic drop negligible or compensated.

parameters.material_source: Pure-metal reference profile: EW = IUPAC standard atomic weight / assumed valence n; density = handbook value for the pure metal at ~20 C. Verify against your specimen; not valid for alloys or coated surfaces.

assumptions: Uniform corrosion over the exposed area.
Faradaic dissolution of the metal with the stated equivalent weight.
i_corr from the selected electrochemical analysis is representative of the exposure period.
